kind: gen_input (VASP DFT+U+SOC input sets: static SCF + NSCF band line)
provenance: rubric and structure reference from 3_reproduction/L8/ (canonical M||-c chain: scf_mneg + bands_mneg on the relax_final geometry); see ../../../3_reproduction/L8/index.md and result.json
structure_reference_provenance: reference/POSCAR symlinks 3_reproduction/L8/hpc_computations/relax_final/CONTCAR -- our self-consistently relaxed monolayer 2H-RuCl2 cell (P-6m2 #187, a=3.5095 A, c=20 A cell height). The SAME file is staged to the agent as agent/POSCAR_2H_RuCl2; both graded runs must use this geometry. No relaxation is graded here (scf and bands are both static/NSCF), the existing 0.1 A structure policy is retained.

structure_match.note: 2H-RuCl2 is non-polar (a sigma_h mirror through the Ru plane makes the two Cl equivalent) and single-layer, so it has no polarity/sublattice/layer-order absorption hazard: the species-aware StructureMatcher fails every designed-wrong variant (Ru<->Cl swap, 1T octahedral polymorph, wrong a, wrong Cl height). Verified in selfcheck.py; a fallback (translation-only) run also passes the reference and fails the same variants.

dftu.note: Declared pin: Dudarev (LDAUTYPE effectively 2; the VASP default, omit passes) single effective U = 2 eV on Ru-4d (LDAUL Ru=2; Cl carries no U: LDAUL=-1, or any shell with effective U within 0.2 eV of zero, which is the same physics). Graded as effective U = LDAUU - LDAUJ within 2.0 +/- 0.2 eV so LDAUU=2/LDAUJ=0 and any (U,J) with U-J=2 both pass (the +/-0.2 band = 10% of the pin, graded as consistency with the value printed in the prompt).

band_path_points.note: The specified vertices define the valley labels in the staged reciprocal basis. K and Kprime are time-reversed corners modulo a reciprocal vector; (2/3,+1/3,0) is not a valley corner in this basis. Line-mode and equivalent explicit reciprocal/Cartesian lists are accepted; the four required vertices are matched within 1e-3 per component. Density, segment count and order are not graded.

kmesh_reference.note: As-run reproduction mesh provenance. Grading uses the separate frozen kmesh_policy; centering and vacuum requirements remain independent.

incar_required.note: Each rule grades the EFFECTIVE value (explicit if set, else the VASP default). Only these settings are graded; the per-tag triage and the VASP defaults are in notes.md. 'both' = scf and bands; others are per-run.
incar_required.ENCUT_both: ENCUT >= max ENMAX over {Ru_pv 230.429, Cl 280.000} = 280 eV (pseudopotential floor)
incar_required.LASPH_both: LASPH=.TRUE. (open d-shell + DFT+U aspherical gradient; default .FALSE.)
incar_required.LMAXMIX_both: LMAXMIX >= 4 (DFT+U d-electron on-site mixing; default 2; carried into the ICHARG=11 NSCF)
incar_required.LSORBIT_both: LSORBIT=.TRUE. (noncollinear SOC = the valley Zeeman split; default .FALSE.)
incar_required.LDAU_both: Dudarev U_eff=2 eV on Ru-4d (see dftu)
incar_required.SAXIS_both: SAXIS effectively (0,0,1), spin axis || c (default (0,0,1)); on bands the same frame as the density it reads
incar_required.LCHARG_scf: LCHARG effectively .TRUE. (the bands run reads this density; default .TRUE.)
incar_required.MAGMOM_scf: Noncollinear explicit MAGMOM, Ru |z|>=0.5 and z-dominant in the supported spin frame. Either global sign allowed; this seed criterion is not proof of convergence.
incar_required.kmesh_scf: Frozen automatic-default minima from kmesh_policy, with the separately specified centering, vacuum and method constraints.
incar_required.ICHARG_bands: ICHARG=11 (NSCF from the fixed SCF charge; default 2)
incar_required.kpath_bands: Line-mode or explicit reciprocal/Cartesian band points containing Gamma,K,M,Kprime within 1e-3 per fractional component; density and segment order are not graded.
incar_required.self_consistent_charge_scf: SCF must update charge: ICHARG omitted or one of 0,1,2,4,5. No startup-file or restart-source check.

score: 1 only if BOTH runs (scf, bands) pass their structure match AND every REQUIRED INCAR/KPOINTS check; any single failure scores 0

kmesh_policy.source: Trusted reference input cell per run label; geometry-based density shared by VASP, QE and ABACUS. No inference from submitted settings.
kmesh_policy.rule: Each periodic-axis subdivision >= automatic default, without subtraction or relative margin. Vacuum axes are exactly 1. Berry strings retain their independent longitudinal condition.
